sources.source_date: not stated; service layer is maintained by Purdue
sources.source_crs: EPSG:3857 service geometry; checked-in snapshot coordinates are WGS84/EPSG:4326
sources.measurement: GIS exterior ring transformed into the project campus approximation (X east, Y north), then the manifest placement origin was subtracted so the asset geometry is building-local; simplified by at most about 0.75 m for mesh-ready facades; no scale fit
sources.uncertainty: Feature identity is supported by the ABE code, full name and street address. The source is a cartographic outline, not a measured wall survey; it does not describe facade segmentation or clarify units on its extrusion field.

sources.provider: Purdue University, Agricultural and Biological Engineering, Final Planning Document
sources.source_date: planning document; source dates to 2017 project planning
sources.measurement: Text-extracted design narrative: identifies an approximately 11,000 NSF 1928 building, an approximately 30,000 NSF 1940 addition, a one-storey south wing to be removed, and a planned four-storey addition with basement and penthouse. Planning proposal rather than as-built survey.
sources.uncertainty: Preconstruction option document. Its planned massing and floor design may differ from the completed building; it does not provide a georeferenced elevation for this model.

sources.measurement: Architect reports renovation of an existing three-storey 37,000-square-foot building and replacement of a demolished one-storey structure by a five-storey 125,000-square-foot research facility.
sources.uncertainty: Project description verifies story-count program and uses, not level elevations or which GIS shell edges belong to each construction phase.

sources.measurement: Confirms that historic photographs and the earlier ABE building archive are associated with this facility.
sources.uncertainty: Archive page alone does not provide current measured elevations.

sources.provider: Farm Progress, photographed ABE virtual tour entrance
sources.source_date: article date not recorded in inherited project evidence
sources.measurement: Visual cue for brick and pale-stone entrance framing and the 1928 marker above the entry.
sources.uncertainty: Photograph is not calibrated to GIS and cannot establish the entrance side, dimensions, or window cadence.

coordinate_method.axes: X east, Y north, Z up
coordinate_method.local_coordinate_formula: local_x = campus_approx_x - placement_origin_x; local_y = campus_approx_y - placement_origin_y
coordinate_method.uncertainty: Project compatibility approximation, not a survey-grade projected CRS.

model.levels: five above-grade floors in the main shell; three-storey retained component is documented but its exact boundary in plan is unresolved, so no invented split is claimed
model.height_status: estimated; five floors at approximately 3.6 m each; Purdue GIS also records an extrusion attribute of 58 with unspecified units, equivalent to 17.68 m only if feet
model.roof: flat roof with a low parapet and a compact schematic mechanical screen; exact rooftop arrangement unverified
model.facade: brick field, pale horizontal trim and repeated glazing are qualitative project-photo cues; detailed bay positions and the exact location of the curtain-wall wing remain approximate
model.entry: photographed stone surround and 1928 lintel marker; assigned to the longest GIS edge for presentation because the photo cannot be georeferenced
model.interior: not modeled; no public as-built floor plan available
geometry_edits: Recreated the dedicated detailed asset because the manifest-referenced .blend and prior builder script were absent from the checkout; older preview images and a GIS/evidence snapshot were present.
Created a mesh-ready shell from the matched GIS exterior ring after subtracting the manifest placement origin, keeping all geometry in building-local coordinates.
Added estimated five-floor fenestration, brick material, parapet, roof screen and photograph-based entrance features.
Preserved the manifest ID, collection name, and placement origin. Applying that origin once recovers the Purdue GIS campus footprint; no campus translation is baked into the asset.

validation.external_texture_dependencies: none intended; procedural material nodes only
validation.status: Local-frame rebuild and Blender reopen validation passed; awaiting independent regrade

uncertainties: GIS footprint shape and position are cartographic, not measured wall lines; the outline is down-sampled for facade detailing.
Exact retained-versus-new addition boundary and orientation were not located in a georeferenced plan, so the model does not assert that partition.
Total above-grade height and floor-to-floor dimensions are estimates; GIS level and extrusion attributes are not survey measurements.
The roof-screen equipment and window bay cadence are schematic.
Photographic entrance cues are not aligned to a known GIS side and are placed illustratively.
Street-level imagery was not independently checked during this pass.
